name: ASAP! Summer Camp
description_short: An arts and outdoor day camp for grades 1-10, held in August at Rumsey Hall School in Washington, CT, from 9:00 am to 3:30 pm. Professional teaching artists lead visual, culinary and performing arts, plus nature hikes, an adventure course, climbing and field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Full tuition refund for cancellations before June 1; 50% refund for cancellations June 1-30; no refund for cancellations on or after July 1.
